description: This Java source file implements a thread-unsafe wrapper around the MongoDB reactive client, providing methods to configure, instantiate, and access MongoDB functionalities, including database and collection management, session handling, and change streams.

classes.name: MongoClientWrapper
classes.description: A thread-unsafe class that wraps the MongoDB reactive client, managing connection setup, access to databases and collections, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: MongoClientWrapperBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring and constructing instances of MongoClientWrapper with customizable options such as SSL, connection pooling, and read preferences.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new MongoClientWrapper instance based on the provided MongoDbConfig.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder for constructing a MongoClientWrapper from scratch or with initial configuration.

methods.name: getDefaultDatabase
methods.description: Returns the default MongoDatabase instance configured during creation.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Returns a MongoCollection<Document> for the given collection name.

methods.name: listDatabaseNames
methods.description: Returns a Publisher that emits database names.

methods.name: listDatabases
methods.description: Returns a publisher for listing databases.

methods.name: watch
methods.description: Creates a change stream publisher to listen to database changes.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the MongoClient and shuts down the event loop group if applicable.
